title: Redmi Phone with 7500mAh Battery to Launch Soon
summary: A new Redmi phone with a 7500mAh battery is set to launch soon. The phone will have a 50MP camera and a full display. The price of the phone has been leaked as ₹8,599. The phone's features include a 90Hz display and military-grade durability.
summary_points: A new Redmi phone with a 7500mAh battery is set to launch soon
The phone will have a 50MP camera
The price of the phone has been leaked as ₹8,599
The phone's features include a 90Hz display and military-grade durability
